name: everythingscraper/trip-hotel-scraper
what_it_holds: Global hotel data feed method pulling Trip.com prices, ratings, and availability across 51 countries. No committed historical dataset found; a live-pull tool.
why_useful: Trip.com/Ctrip is the dominant APAC OTA; a working price/availability puller could be adapted for a point-in-time APAC hotel-rate panel not otherwise available (gaps #2, #9).

name: factden/makemytrip-scraper
what_it_holds: Apify actor scraping MakeMyTrip and Goibibo (India) hotel reviews and hotel details (star class, coordinates, sub-ratings: Location/Cleanliness/Facilities/Food/Room/Value/Child-friendliness). Repo includes an examples/ folder with committed real sample review data for docs. MIT license, 10 commits.
why_useful: India is a fast-growing APAC short-term-lodging market with no coverage in the team's current holdings; hotel sub-ratings and review velocity could proxy Indian travel demand.

name: Abhi2303shek/OYO
what_it_holds: Committed oyo.csv dataset plus oyo.sql and Cleaning.ipynb, analyzing OYO (India-based budget-hotel chain, also present in SE Asia) pricing structure, ratings/popularity, discount effectiveness, and location-based insights. Segments hotels into Budget/Mid-range/Premium. MIT license, only 3 commits (small, likely a class project scrape, exact row count and city coverage not disclosed in README).
why_useful: OYO is a large budget-STR chain across India/SE Asia that competes with Airbnb for price-sensitive travelers; a real (if small, uncertain vintage) pricing dataset is rare for this segment.

name: vrbo-calendar-scraper
what_it_holds: Small Python (mechanize-based) scraper that pulls a single VRBO listing's calendar and returns a list of available dates. No committed dataset, no bulk-market capability as-is, minimal/no recent maintenance signal.
why_useful: Points at a feasible route to VRBO/HomeAway (Expedia Group) calendar availability, which would be a genuinely new competitor-supply data source (gap #9) not covered by anything we currently hold — but it is a single-listing tool that would need to be built out into a market-level crawler, and scraping vrbo.com is the same terms-of-service question as scraping airbnb.com.
themes: Airbnb calendar / availability / blocked-night datasets and occupancy-estimation code (San Francisco model, review-to-booking ratios)
Vrbo / HomeAway datasets and scrapers, Vrbo listing snapshots, Expedia Group vacation rental supply data
why_all: Points at a feasible route to VRBO/HomeAway (Expedia Group) calendar availability, which would be a genuinely new competitor-supply data source (gap #9) not covered by anything we currently hold — but it is a single-listing tool that would need to be built out into a market-level crawler, and scraping vrbo.com is the same terms-of-service question as scraping airbnb.com.

Method for pulling Vrbo per-listing calendar availability, which is the raw ingredient behind occupancy/booking-lead-time metrics (gap #2/#3) analogous to Inside Airbnb calendar dumps, but scoped to one listing at a time with no aggregation or committed panel.
